item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Users report being unable to log in or access their accounts, sometimes after repeated attempts.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Login and account access problems"},{"description":"Users describe premium prompts, difficulty signing up for Premium, and limited access to music without a subscription.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Premium access and subscription barriers"},{"description":"Users report missing songs or lyrics, repetitive playback choices, and recommendations that have worsened.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Missing music and weaker recommendations"},{"description":"Users report trouble downloading music, listening offline, and keeping downloaded files available.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Download and offline listening problems"},{"description":"Users express broad dissatisfaction with the app or say a recent update needs rework.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General app dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Users report playback that stops, fails to start, shows a blank screen, or plays unexpected content.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback interruptions and failures"},{"description":"Users report changed or missing controls, difficulty navigating playlists or finding features, and frequent ads.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Navigation, controls, and ad interruptions"}]}
